<thought>We have the list of valid functional group names. To find a template that matches the Doebner modification, we will search the template catalog for the product cinnamic acid (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). The forward reaction breaks an aldehyde and forms a C‑C double bond. Therefore we set functional_groups_broken to ["aldehydes"] and functional_groups_formed to ["C-C double bonds"]. We also include bond changes: breaking a C=O bond and forming a C‑C single bond. We'll request up to 10 templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1", "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"], "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"], "bonds_broken": ["C=O"], "bonds_formed": ["C-C"], "limit": 10}</action_input>
